name: claimgate-kit
display_name: ClaimGate starter kit - set up a publish gate
description: Start a publish gate for AI-assisted marketing copy: a policy file, an evidence folder and a CI job that fails the build on unsubstantiated claims.
long_description:
The free half of ClaimGate, as a tool an agent can call.

`init_kit` writes a starter kit into a directory you name:

* `policy.json` - the claims your organisation may not make, blocked or flagged when a draft breaks them;
* `evidence/` - the folder the gate treats as evidence; a figure that appears in no file here is caught by plain string comparison;
* `CHECKLIST.md` - the six pre-publish questions, including the EU AI Act Article 50 disclosure section;
* `.github/workflows/claimgate.yml` - the same gate running on every pull request that touches a `.md` file.

`check_kit` then runs that gate on a draft, offline: no API key and no network call. `list_claims` shows what the gate will demand substantiation for. `check_policy_only` answers "would our own rules let this out of the door".

It fails closed. No evidence supplied means every claim is `unverified`, never `supported`; a figure in no evidence is `unsupported`; and because no model is consulted, `unverified` blocks - a gate that passes what it could not check is decoration.

It is a checker, not a writer. It does not browse, does not invent facts, and does not write your copy.

The engine that adjudicates each claim against your evidence is the paid listing; the source of both is MIT and public: https://github.com/caseone115/claimgate

Disclosure: this software is written and maintained by automated software.
